**Divergences from SellerOrgPage (§4.4.10).**

- Publication additionally requires `claim_status=claim_verified` on the parent SellerSoftware; enforced at state transition with `seller_software_page_requires_verified_claim`.
- Slug changes before publication may be propagated from SellerSoftware slug changes; post-publication slug is immutable.
- Category reassignment on the parent SellerSoftware triggers a re-validation sweep: if the new Category is `deprecated` without successor, SoftwarePage transitions to `pending_review` automatically.
- `schema_org_payload_json` emits `Product` rather than `Organization` as the root type.

**Retention, DSAR, Residency.** Identical to SellerOrgPage (§4.4.10). On parent SellerSoftware soft-delete, SoftwarePage transitions to `archived` and the URL returns HTTP 410 for 30 days before hard-purge.

**Failure Modes Addressed.**

1. **Parent SellerSoftware claim revoked.** Cascades to SoftwarePage `suppressed_by_opt_out` with synthetic opt-out (authored extension).
2. **Category deprecation without successor.** Sweep transitions SoftwarePage to `pending_review` and pages Ops; manual Category reassignment required before re-publish.
3. **Slug collision between SellerOrgPage and SoftwarePage.** Namespaces are distinct (`/sellers/:slug` vs `/software/:slug`); both routes accept independent slug namespaces. Collision within the SoftwarePage namespace enforced by `(slug)` unique index.

**Acceptance Criteria.**

1. Publishing a SoftwarePage whose parent SellerSoftware has `claim_status != claim_verified` MUST be rejected with `seller_software_page_requires_verified_claim` (already in Appendix I per §4.4.9 acceptance criterion).
2. Category deprecation on the parent MUST transition this SoftwarePage to `pending_review` within 60s.
3. All SellerOrgPage acceptance criteria (§4.4.10) apply, adapted to SoftwarePage FKs.

### 4.4.12 CategoryPage (Marketplace-Domain, Sourcera-Owned, Public) {#4.4.12-categorypage}

**Authoring Intent.** CategoryPage is the AI-generated, editorially-reviewed per-category Marketplace landing page per Summary C.67 / M9 — e.g., "Best HRMS for Mid-Market." Powered by the `category_faq_generation` capability. Sourcera-owned: AI operations billed to the Platform Marketing internal cost center, never to a customer. k-anonymity floor of **k=5** enforced on any metric/fact sourced from aggregated buyer signals (buyer count, average evaluation duration, common requirement themes).

**Scope:** Marketplace-domain; Sourcera-owned (`org_id` is null — ownership is the Sourcera platform, not a customer Org). Write access restricted to Ops Console roles `ops_marketing_editor` and `ops_platform_admin`; no customer-side write access. Read access public.

**Scope Isolation.** No `org_id`; no Org-scoped ACLs. All customer-visible fields are public. Generation + editorial workflow runs entirely in the Ops Console. The page MUST never render vendor names in `referenced_vendor_opt_out_map_json`; enforced by a serializer test that walks `body_sections_json` and `vendor_shortlist_seller_software_ids` against the opt-out map.

**k-Anonymity Enforcement (k=5).** Any metric rendered on this page that is derived from buyer-side aggregates (e.g., "Average evaluation duration: 6 weeks across N buyers") MUST have `underlying_signal_count ≥ 5` per rendered metric. At render, any metric failing the floor is replaced with the placeholder "Insufficient data" and logged to `posthog.category_page_k_anon_gate_hit`. Publication is permitted with `k_anon_satisfied=false` only if the page contains zero aggregate-derived metrics (pure editorial content); the check is enforced at state transition to `published`.

**State Machine.** Same as `page_publication_status` (see §4.4.10), plus one added transition:

| From | To | Trigger | Conditions | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `published` | `pending_review` | `next_scheduled_refresh_at` reached | Refresh job runs `category_faq_generation`; editorial-required categories re-enter review | If `editorial_review_status=not_required` (trivial refresh), transitions straight back to `published` without human review — allowed for minor version bumps where the diff-score from the last approved version is <10% (authored extension; flagged) |

**Retention.** Published rows: life of platform unless Category deprecated (archive after deprecation + 180 days; 301-redirect to successor CategoryPage). Rejected drafts retained 90 days then purged. DSAR: not applicable (no PII authored on platform-generated pages); referenced vendor identities are governed by the Opt-Out Registry.

**Failure Modes Addressed.**

1. **`category_faq_generation` failure.** Refresh job fails; page remains on prior `content_version`; Ops alerted after 3 consecutive failures.
2. **k-anon drops after publication** (signal cohort shrinks below floor due to DSAR or opt-out). Nightly sweep sets `k_anon_satisfied=false` and transitions aggregate-dependent pages to `pending_review`.
3. **Referenced vendor opts out after publication.** Render-path redaction using `referenced_vendor_opt_out_map_json`; `vendor_opt_out.applied` webhook fans out a cache-bust within 15 minutes.
4. **Editorial reviewer unavailable.** Queue depth alert at >20 pages pending review for >7 days.

**Acceptance Criteria.**

1. Publishing with `k_anon_satisfied=false` AND any rendered aggregate metric MUST be rejected with `category_page_k_anon_floor_not_met` (new; Appendix I; HTTP 409).
2. `category_faq_generation` runs MUST be tagged `cost_center=sourcera_owned` in the Usage Event ledger (§4.3.18); any run tagged with a customer Org MUST be flagged and reversed via §34.14 Outcome Resolver.
3. A referenced SellerSoftware acquiring an active opt-out MUST cause this page to redact the vendor row within 15 minutes and emit `category_page.vendor_redacted`.
4. Category deprecation MUST transition all CategoryPages for that Category to `archived` within 24 hours and install a 301 redirect to the successor Category's CategoryPage.
5. A deterministic regression test (§44.4 load-style) validates that no metric rendered on a published CategoryPage references a signal cohort <5.

**Opt-Out Redaction Rule.** At render, each entry in `compared_seller_software_ids` is evaluated against the Opt-Out Registry. Structured data (`schema_org_payload_json`) excludes suppressed `Product`s entirely. If `|compared_seller_software_ids| - |suppressed_seller_software_ids| < 2`, the page transitions to `archived` (below the minimum of 2 products for a valid comparison) and the URL 410-gones. This is authored extension — flagged.

1. **All vendors in a comparison opt out.** Archive-on-min-count transition; 410-gone.
2. **A SellerSoftware referenced in a comparison is hard-purged.** Element removed from `compared_seller_software_ids`; downstream min-count check fires.
3. **Editorial disagrees with AI-generated winner_by_use_case.** Editor can rewrite `winner_by_use_case_json`; `guide_refresh_analysis` cost NOT reversed (the content was valid; human judgment diverges).

**Acceptance Criteria.**

1. Publication with `|compared_seller_software_ids| < 2` after suppression MUST be rejected with `comparison_page_insufficient_vendors` (new; Appendix I; HTTP 409).
2. `schema_org_payload_json` MUST never list an opted-out `Product`; automated Schema.org validator in QA suite.
3. When a `suppressed_seller_software_ids` transition reduces non-suppressed count below 2, the page MUST archive + 410-gone within 15 minutes.
4. Editorial review MUST be completed before any publish; automated publish without `editorial_review_status=approved` MUST be rejected.

**Indexes.** `(category_id, report_period_end DESC)`, `(slug)` unique, `(publication_status)`, `(editorial_review_status, updated_at)`, `(residency_region_scope)`.

**Scope Isolation.** Public read. The `per_metric_k_anon_audit_json` field MUST NEVER surface raw per-metric signal counts below `k_anon_floor` to the public projection; the serializer emits the audit only to Ops endpoints.

**k-Anonymity Enforcement (k=20).** Every rendered metric carries an explicit per-metric signal count check. Metrics below floor are either (a) aggregated into a coarser band until count ≥20, or (b) suppressed with placeholder text. Enforcement runs at generation time (rejects generation run if `minimum_signal_count_satisfied=false`) and at publish time (rejects publish if any rendered metric fails the audit). Runtime evaluation is additionally performed on every public render; a metric whose cohort shrunk below 20 post-publication (e.g., due to DSAR) triggers an immediate re-render with suppression and a `market_intel.k_anon_degradation` webhook.

**Residency Enforcement.** If `residency_region_scope != global`, the underlying signal cohort MUST be filtered at generation time to signals from Orgs in the specified region. A cross-region leak fails the generation run and emits `market_intel_residency_violation` (new; Appendix I; HTTP 422). Reports published per-region may be discoverable globally but carry a `region:scope` hreflang meta tag.

**State Machine.** `page_publication_status`, with the added requirement that `editorial_review_status=approved` requires both Marketing and Finance sign-off timestamps non-null.

**Retention.** Published reports: platform-life, with archive after 8 quarters. Archived reports retain their URL with `X-Robots-Tag: noindex`; PDF download redirects to a "Report archived" landing page. DSAR: aggregates retain anonymized content; any PII that leaked into narrative text is subject to targeted redaction (Ops-driven) within 30 days.

**Failure Modes Addressed.**

1. **Signal cohort below k=20 at generation.** Generation aborts; Ops alerted; report skipped for the quarter (next quarter retry).
2. **DSAR reduces cohort post-publication.** `market_intel.k_anon_degradation` + re-render with coarser aggregation or suppression.
3. **Marketing and Finance reviewers disagree.** Page held in `revision_requested`; dual sign-off required before publish.
4. **Residency leak.** Generation-time check rejects; Ops paged; no report published for that region-period.

**Acceptance Criteria.**

1. Publishing without both Marketing and Finance review timestamps MUST be rejected with `market_intel_dual_signoff_required` (new; Appendix I; HTTP 409).
2. Any rendered metric with an audit row showing `count < 20` MUST fail the publish gate with `market_intel_k_anon_floor_not_met` (new; Appendix I; HTTP 409).
3. Cross-region signal leak at generation MUST be detected and aborted; QA regression test asserts the check.
4. Reports older than 8 quarters MUST auto-transition to `archived` via nightly sweep.

### 4.4.16 HeatMapCell (Marketplace-Domain, Sourcera-Owned, Aggregated, Public) {#4.4.16-heatmapcell}

**Authoring Intent.** HeatMapCell represents a single aggregated demand cell for the Public Marketplace Heat Map per Summary C.71 / M13. Each cell is the intersection of `(category, region, industry, company_size_band, period)`. k-anonymity floor of **k=10** enforced. No vendor names ever appear on heat-map cells (aggregate demand only), so vendor opt-out is structurally inapplicable — however, `vendor_opt_out_honored_at` is still stamped per the prompt's requirement for uniform source-of-truth linkage, with a sentinel `scope_kind=not_applicable` record in the registry.

**Scope:** Marketplace-domain, Sourcera-owned, public read.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Auto-generated |
| `category_id` | UUID | FK → Marketplace Category (§4.4.7) | — |
| `region_code` | String | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 OR macro-region (`global`, `us`, `eu`, `apac`, `latam`, `mea`) | Stored as uppercase |
| `industry_code` | String | NAICS 2-digit or industry taxonomy slug | Coarse industry band to preserve k-anon |
| `company_size_band` | Enum | See Appendix J `heat_map_company_size_band`: `1-50`, `51-500`, `501-5000`, `5000+` | Coarsened size band |
| `period_start` | Date | ISO | Period inclusive |
| `period_end` | Date | ISO | Period inclusive; typical period = 14 days (matches `refresh_cadence_days`) |
| `signal_count` | Integer | ≥ 0 | Total contributing signals in the cell |
| `k_anon_floor` | Integer | 10 (fixed) | Per Summary §3.5 |
| `k_anon_satisfied` | Boolean | Computed | `signal_count ≥ k_anon_floor` |
| `demand_index` | Decimal | 0.0–100.0; NULL when `k_anon_satisfied=false` | Normalized demand score |
| `demand_trend` | Enum | See Appendix J `heat_map_demand_trend`: `up`, `flat`, `down`, `insufficient_data` | Computed against prior period |
| `prior_period_signal_count` | Integer | ≥ 0; nullable | For trend computation |
| `contributing_source_hash` | String | SHA-256 hex; 64 chars | Hash of contributing Workspace IDs; used to verify derivation determinism without revealing identity |
| `last_refreshed_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | — |
| `refresh_cadence_days` | Integer | Default 14; range 7–60 | — |
| `next_scheduled_refresh_at` | Timestamp | Auto-computed | — |
| `publication_status` | Enum | `page_publication_status` (subset: `draft`, `published`, `suppressed_by_opt_out`, `archived` only — Heat Map has no editorial review gate) | Auto-published when `k_anon_satisfied=true` |
| `vendor_opt_out_honored_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Stamped on each refresh; always `scope_kind=not_applicable` resolution for cells |
| `residency_region_scope` | Enum | `market_intel_residency_scope` | Governs which residency regions' signals contributed |

**Indexes.** `(category_id, region_code, industry_code, company_size_band, period_start)` unique, `(next_scheduled_refresh_at)` partial, `(k_anon_satisfied, publication_status)`, `(residency_region_scope)`.

**Scope Isolation.** Public read. No `org_id`; no customer-side write. The heat map UI renders only cells with `k_anon_satisfied=true`; cells below floor render as "Insufficient data."

**k-Anonymity Enforcement (k=10).** At refresh, cells below floor set `demand_index=null` and `demand_trend=insufficient_data`. Cells below floor remain in `published` status (for index continuity) but render suppressed on the public UI. Across-cell aggregation to next-coarser bands occurs only via a separate reporting surface; never inside this entity.

**Retention.** 24 months of cells retained in raw form. After 24 months, raw cells purged and replaced with quarterly roll-ups stored in MarketIntelligenceReport. DSAR: not applicable (no user-level data; aggregates only).

**Failure Modes Addressed.**

1. **Signal cohort shrinks below floor due to opt-out cascade.** Cell transitions to `k_anon_satisfied=false`; `demand_index` nulled; UI renders suppressed.
2. **Residency leakage.** Refresh worker's source filter guarantees signals are from the chosen region; anomaly detector checks cross-region leakage nightly.
3. **Stale cells (refresh worker outage).** Cells older than `2 × refresh_cadence_days` are flagged `stale=true` in a separate derived column (not in table; computed); UI shows a "data may be stale" banner.

**Acceptance Criteria.**

1. A cell with `signal_count < 10` MUST never expose `demand_index` via any public endpoint; serializer test enforces.
2. Cross-region leakage in contributing signal set MUST be detected and the refresh aborted with `heat_map_residency_violation` (new; Appendix I; HTTP 422).
3. Cells older than 24 months MUST be purged; nightly sweep enforces.

| `source_file_byte_size` | Integer | ≥ 0; ≤ 250MB per §39 addition | Per-import file size cap |
| `raw_text` | Text | ≤ 2,000,000 chars | Extracted raw text (pasted or OCR'd) |
| `parsed_qa_pairs_json` | JSON | ≤ 1,000,000 chars | Structured Q/A pairs produced by `ghost_rfp_ingestion` |
| `parsed_entry_count` | Integer | ≥ 0 | Number of KB entries produced |
| `import_status` | Enum | See Appendix J `ghost_bid_import_status`: `draft`, `parsing`, `parsed`, `review_pending`, `publishing`, `published`, `rejected`, `failed` | See state machine |
| `parse_capability_ref` | String | Enum: `ghost_rfp_ingestion` | — |
| `parse_capability_run_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK → AI Operation ledger | Links to the AI operation |
| `is_first_import_free_for_org` | Boolean | Computed at creation | True iff no prior GhostBidImport in `published` state for this Org |
| `billing_ai_operation_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK → AI Operation ledger | Populated on second+ import |
| `failure_reason` | String | 0–1000 chars; nullable | Populated when `import_status=failed` or `rejected` |
| `rejected_by_role` | Enum | See Appendix J `ghost_bid_import_rejected_by_role`: `seller_user`, `ops_moderation`, `content_validator`; nullable | Who rejected (if rejected) |
| `duplicate_of_import_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; self-FK | Populated when dedup sweep matches a prior import |
| `imported_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Set when `import_status=published` |
| `reviewed_by` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; Seller User ID | Reviewer |
| `reviewed_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | — |
| `retention_tier` | Enum | `data_retention_tier`: `standard` | — |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | UTC |
| `created_by` | UUID (FK) | Seller User ID | Creator |
| `updated_by` | UUID (FK) | Seller User ID | Last editor |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft delete |

**Indexes.** `(org_id, import_status, created_at)`, `(target_kb_namespace_id)`, `(duplicate_of_import_id)` partial, `(is_first_import_free_for_org)` partial (for Ops analytics).

**Scope Isolation.** Seller-console only. Buyer-console MUST return 404. Imports route exclusively into the owning Seller Org's KB namespaces; cross-Org namespace references rejected with `ghost_bid_import_cross_org_namespace` (new; Appendix I; HTTP 422).

**First-Import-Free Rule.** `is_first_import_free_for_org` is computed at creation time by checking `COUNT(*) WHERE org_id=? AND import_status='published' AND deleted_at IS NULL = 0`. If true, no AI Operation ledger entry is created; `billing_ai_operation_id` remains null. Concurrent imports racing for the first-free slot: the first to reach `published` wins; a later racing import flips `is_first_import_free_for_org=false` and creates its billing ledger entry retroactively (triggered by a post-publish reconciliation worker). Authored extension — flagged. Refund semantics follow §34.14 Outcome Resolver if the retroactive bill is disputed.

**State Machine (`import_status`).**

| From | To | Trigger | Conditions | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| (init) | `draft` | Seller creates row | — | Upload/paste not yet finalized |
| `draft` | `parsing` | Seller submits for parse | `raw_text` non-empty OR `source_file_attachment_id` non-null | `ghost_rfp_ingestion` AI operation begins |
| `parsing` | `parsed` | `ghost_rfp_ingestion` returns success | `parsed_qa_pairs_json` populated; `parsed_entry_count > 0` | — |
| `parsing` | `failed` | `ghost_rfp_ingestion` returns failure | `failure_reason` populated | No billing (failure reversal per §34.14) |
| `parsed` | `review_pending` | Auto-advance | — | Seller reviewer required |
| `review_pending` | `publishing` | Reviewer approves | Reviewer holds `seller_kb_editor` role | Writes entries into KB namespace |
| `publishing` | `published` | KB write succeeds | All entries indexed | `imported_at` stamped; billing entry created if not first-import-free |
| `publishing` | `failed` | KB write fails | `failure_reason` populated | Partial writes rolled back |
| `review_pending` | `rejected` | Reviewer rejects | `rejected_by_role=seller_user` | Entries discarded |
| Any non-terminal | `rejected` | Content validator fires | `rejected_by_role=content_validator` | Per Summary §3.5 anti-spam controls |

**Retention & DSAR.**

- `raw_text` and `parsed_qa_pairs_json`: retained 90 days after `import_status=published`, then purged; KB entries produced remain for KB-entry retention (per KB_Engineering_Spec §5.4).
- Rejected or failed imports: purged 30 days after terminal state.
- DSAR: `raw_text` scanned for PII; any targeted user's PII redacted within 30 days.
- Residency: imports stored in the Seller Org's data region.

**Failure Modes Addressed.**

1. **Parse fails due to malformed document.** `import_status=failed`; Outcome Resolver reverses billing; seller notified with remediation steps.
2. **Content validator flags spam/adversarial content.** `rejected_by_role=content_validator`; Org SIM (C.100) credited with a flag.
3. **Duplicate imports.** A dedup sweep (SHA-256 of normalized `raw_text`) sets `duplicate_of_import_id`; duplicates skip billing and auto-reject after 7 days if not superseded.
4. **Target namespace deleted mid-parse.** Parse job aborts; `import_status=failed` with `failure_reason='target_namespace_deleted'`.

**Acceptance Criteria.**

1. Creating a GhostBidImport with `source_file_byte_size > 250MB` MUST be rejected with `ghost_bid_import_file_too_large` (new; Appendix I; HTTP 413).
2. The first successful `published` import per Org MUST NOT produce an AI Operation billing record; second+ imports MUST.
3. Content validator rejection MUST be logged in audit with the triggering validator rule (per §3.5 anti-spam controls).
4. Duplicate dedup MUST be enforced server-side (SHA-256 of normalized `raw_text`); duplicates MUST NOT consume the first-import-free slot.
5. KB namespace write failures MUST roll back all entries atomically; partial KB state is disallowed.

### 4.4.18 SellerSignal (Platform-Scoped, Aggregated, Seller-Visible) {#4.4.18-sellersignal}

**Authoring Intent.** SellerSignal is the anonymized, aggregated buyer-intent record per Summary §6.17. Buyers opt in (off by default) to signal sharing; signals are stripped of all PII and aggregated to a k-anonymity floor of **k=5**. Sellers consume signals via in-app Seller Dashboard, weekly digest, and CRM Sync. De-anonymization happens only when the buyer explicitly sends an EOI or direct invite (transitioning the signal to a one-off de-anonymization record tied to that EOI).

**Scope:** Platform-scoped (no `org_id` on the record; the aggregate is cross-Org). Distribution targets are Seller Orgs via a separate `SellerSignalDelivery` index (authored extension; deferred). Read access is gated by Seller plan entitlements (Growth tier and up); access-control check performed at the delivery layer, not on the signal rows.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Auto-generated |
| `category_id` | UUID | FK → Marketplace Category | Primary category |
| `secondary_category_ids` | Array\[UUID\] | 0–3 entries; FKs → Marketplace Category | Additional categories |
| `industry_code` | String | NAICS 2-digit or taxonomy slug | Coarse industry band |
| `region_code` | String | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 OR macro-region | Coarse region |
| `company_size_band` | Enum | `heat_map_company_size_band` | Reuses Heat Map bands |
| `timeline_band` | Enum | See Appendix J `seller_signal_timeline_band`: `urgent_0_30d`, `near_30_90d`, `mid_90_180d`, `long_180d_plus`, `exploratory_no_timeline` | — |
| `intent_strength` | Enum | See Appendix J `seller_signal_intent_strength`: `browsing`, `evaluating`, `shortlisting`, `committed` | Derived from buyer Workspace phase |
| `signal_cohort_count` | Integer | ≥ 0 | Distinct buyer Orgs contributing to this aggregate |
| `contributing_workspace_count` | Integer | ≥ 0 | Workspace-level count |
| `k_anon_floor` | Integer | 5 (fixed) | Summary §3.5 |
| `k_anon_satisfied` | Boolean | Computed | `signal_cohort_count ≥ k_anon_floor` |
| `buyer_opt_in_snapshot_version` | String | Semver; ≤ 32 chars | Version of the buyer-opt-in consent schema at aggregation time |
| `source_capability_ref` | String | Enum: `seller_signal_aggregation` (new; Phase 3 capability registry) | — |
| `signal_period_start` | Date | ISO | Inclusive |
| `signal_period_end` | Date | ISO | Inclusive; period typically 7 days |
| `generated_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC; generation time |
| `expires_at` | Timestamp | Default `generated_at + 30 days` | Signal decays unless refreshed |
| `delivered_via` | Array\[Enum\] | Subset of `seller_signal_delivery_channel` (Appendix J): `in_app_dashboard`, `weekly_digest`, `crm_sync` | Channels that have delivered this signal |
| `residency_region_scope` | Enum | `market_intel_residency_scope` | Signals pre-filtered by residency |
| `vendor_opt_out_honored_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Stamped per refresh; Opt-Out Registry is evaluated because certain delivery channels (CRM Sync) could surface implicit vendor attribution via routing |
| `de_anonymized_eoi_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK → EOI Record (§4.5.2) | Set when the cohort's buyer explicitly sends an EOI to a specific seller |
| `de_anonymized_target_seller_org_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable | Target seller Org for the EOI |
| `de_anonymized_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | — |
| `suppressed_reason` | Enum | See Appendix J `seller_signal_suppressed_reason`: `k_anon_floor_not_met`, `buyer_opt_out`, `residency_mismatch`, `vendor_opt_out`, `expired`; nullable | — |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | UTC |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft delete |

**Indexes.** `(category_id, signal_period_end DESC)`, `(region_code, industry_code, company_size_band)`, `(expires_at)` partial on non-expired, `(k_anon_satisfied, suppressed_reason)`, `(de_anonymized_eoi_id)` partial.

**Scope Isolation.** Sellers see only signals matching their Marketplace footprint (category and region configuration). Buyer identities MUST never appear in the signal row, regardless of k-anon; de-anonymization happens only via `de_anonymized_eoi_id` (which is the buyer's explicit, affirmative action). The Seller-facing API serializer excludes `signal_cohort_count` when `k_anon_satisfied=false` (returns `"insufficient_data"` marker instead).

**Delivery Channel Semantics.**

- `in_app_dashboard`: rendered on Seller Dashboard widgets; subject to opt-out scrub at render.
- `weekly_digest`: dispatched via Loops.so weekly; per-seller aggregation respects seller's email preferences.
- `crm_sync`: pushed into the seller's CRM via §6.18 CRM Sync; creates a "Prospect Category Interest" record type.

**De-Anonymization Flow.** When a buyer sends an EOI (§4.5.2) to a seller, a new row is created linking that specific buyer-Workspace-to-seller relationship. The aggregate SellerSignal row itself is NEVER mutated to reveal identity; instead, the EOI carries the buyer identity, and a pointer-only field (`de_anonymized_eoi_id` + `de_anonymized_target_seller_org_id` + `de_anonymized_at`) is populated to mark that the aggregate has now been partially disambiguated for one seller. Other sellers still see the anonymous aggregate.

**Retention & DSAR.**

- Raw aggregates retained 180 days, then anonymized further (signal_cohort_count rolled into Heat Map).
- DSAR: buyer identity was never present in the aggregate; DSAR on a contributing buyer triggers a recomputation with that buyer excluded. If the recompute drops the cell below k_anon_floor, the signal is suppressed immediately.
- Residency: aggregates computed per-region; cross-region aggregates flagged `residency_region_scope=global` and require explicit Ops approval before delivery.

**Failure Modes Addressed.**

1. **Buyer revokes opt-in post-contribution.** Recompute sweep within 24 hours; signals that drop below k=5 transition to `suppressed_reason=buyer_opt_out`.
2. **Cross-region leak.** Residency enforcement at generation; violation aborts the generation run.
3. **Stale signals delivered via weekly digest.** `expires_at` check gates delivery; expired signals not delivered.
4. **Aggregate inadvertently reveals one buyer** (cohort = 5 but geographic+industry+size bands are narrow enough to identify). Authored extension: a "distinctiveness" secondary check beyond raw count — if any (region, industry, size) tuple has `cohort_count ≤ 5` and the buyer-distinctness score exceeds a configured threshold, the signal is suppressed. Threshold governed via C.97 Baseline Assumption Manager.

**Acceptance Criteria.**

1. A signal with `signal_cohort_count < 5` MUST never deliver via any channel; the delivery layer enforces.
2. Buyer-identity information MUST never appear on a SellerSignal row; serializer test enforces.
3. DSAR on a contributing buyer MUST trigger recomputation within 24 hours; audit event `seller_signal_recompute_dsar` emitted.
4. Cross-region signal leakage MUST abort generation and emit `seller_signal_residency_violation` (new; Appendix I; HTTP 422).
5. Expired signals MUST NOT be delivered; delivery attempts increment the `seller_signal_expired_delivery_blocked` metric.

### 4.5.4 Taxonomy Node (Platform-Scoped, Ops-Managed, Multi-Kind Controlled Vocabulary) {#4.5.4-taxonomy-node}

**Authoring Intent.** Taxonomy Node is the single registry behind every controlled-vocabulary dimension the Marketplace depends on beyond the Marketplace Category dimension authored in §4.4.7. Per Summary C.60 (Marketplace Tags & Controlled Vocabulary) and C.95 (Taxonomy CMS), sellers MUST NOT mint free-form taxonomy values; Capability Declarations (§26.3), Marketplace Listing filters (§4.5.1, §27.3), Seller Profile industries and certifications (§26.1), SoftwarePage structured data (§4.4.11), Heat Map region facets (§4.4.16), and Market Intelligence Report cohort slicers (§4.4.15) all reference this table by FK. Taxonomy Node is Ops-managed, versioned, deprecation-aware (with a successor-pointer migration model), and multi-kind (one table, one state machine, `kind`-scoped namespacing). For `kind=marketplace_category`, Marketplace Category (§4.4.7) is the specialized projection and carries the additional category-specific fields (parent hierarchy, SEO metadata, icon token); Taxonomy Node maintains the shared registry semantics for that kind but defers per-row shape to §4.4.7 (see Cross-Reference to §4.4.7 below).

**Scope:** Platform-scoped (no `org_id`; single global taxonomy). Not console-scoped. Read access is public for rows with `visibility=public` and `state ∈ {active, deprecated}`; rows with `visibility=internal_ops_only` or `visibility=internal_plus_labs` are not resolvable via public or buyer/seller APIs. Write access restricted to the Ops Console role `ops_taxonomy_admin` (defined in Appendix J in Phase 2; reused here). A subset of moderation actions (tag promotion from Controlled-Vocabulary Tag → Taxonomy Node for `kind ∈ {capability_category, integration_vendor}`) may additionally be taken by `ops_marketing_editor`; see §4.5.5 for the seller-proposed promotion flow.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Auto-generated |
| `kind` | Enum | See Appendix J `taxonomy_node_kind`: `marketplace_category`, `capability_category`, `industry`, `certification`, `integration_vendor`, `language`, `region`, `employee_size_band` | Taxonomy dimension. Immutable once persisted; re-keying requires deprecate + re-create |
| `slug` | String | 3–80 chars, lowercase, `^[a-z0-9-]+$`, unique within `kind` | URL segment for any derived public page (e.g., `/capabilities/saml-sso`). Case-insensitive-unique per kind |
| `name` | String | 1–120 chars | Display name (e.g., "SAML SSO") |
| `short_name` | String | 1–40 chars | Compact label for chips and comparison headers |
| `description` | String | 0–2000 chars | Ops-authored markdown description |
| `parent_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK → Taxonomy Node (same `kind`) | Two-level hierarchy max; parent MUST share `kind` |
| `depth` | Integer | 0 or 1 | Computed; enforced at write. Deeper nesting rejected |
| `sort_order` | Integer | ≥ 0 | Display order within `(kind, parent_id)` |
| `icon_token` | String | Nullable; see Appendix J `marketplace_category_icon_token` when `kind=marketplace_category`, otherwise free-form design-system token | Icon reference |
| `aliases` | Array[String] | Max 20 items, each 1–80 chars, globally unique across aliases | Search-only synonyms; do NOT resolve on public paths (avoids ambiguous canonicalization) |
| `state` | Enum | See Appendix J `taxonomy_node_state`: `draft`, `active`, `deprecated`, `merged` | See State Machine below |
| `deprecation_action` | Enum | Nullable; see Appendix J `taxonomy_node_deprecation_action`: `redirect_to_successor`, `redirect_to_parent`, `hard_retire` | Required when `state=deprecated` |
| `successor_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK → Taxonomy Node (same `kind`) | Required when `state=deprecated` and `deprecation_action=redirect_to_successor`; required when `state=merged` |
| `visibility` | Enum | See Appendix J `taxonomy_node_visibility`: `public`, `internal_ops_only`, `internal_plus_labs` | Gates resolution on public paths |
| `version` | Integer | ≥ 1, auto-incremented on Ops edit | Used for cache-bust and downstream consumer versioning |
| `revision_note` | String | 0–1000 chars, nullable | Ops change rationale for audit |
| `marketplace_category_ref_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK → Marketplace Category (§4.4.7) | Populated only when `kind=marketplace_category`; the specialized row holds parent/SEO/icon authority. Application layer enforces 1:1 |
| `seo_metadata_json` | JSON | ≤ 4000 chars, nullable | Defaults for any derived public page (only populated for `kind ∈ {capability_category, certification, integration_vendor}` that may generate a `/capabilities/:slug`, `/certifications/:slug`, or `/integrations/:slug` page in a later phase) |
| `residency_scope` | Enum | See Appendix J `data_residency_region`: `us`, `eu`, `apac`, `custom` or `global` | Controls residency partitioning for reports/signals; defaults to `global` |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | UTC |
